issues.title: Create repo with licence, README, contributing guide and project CLAUDE.md
issues.body:
Scope: public repo with the baseline documents.

Done when:
- LICENSE is MIT with "Copyright (c) 2026 Patrick Kuhn"
- README states what the trainer is and is not, and links the spec
- CONTRIBUTING describes branch, PR and review flow
- CLAUDE.md gives commands and package boundaries

Spec: §2, §10

issues.title: Set up pnpm workspace, TypeScript, ESLint boundary rules and Prettier
issues.body:
Scope: workspace with packages core, panel-kit, aircraft-demo and apps/web, each with one passing test.

Done when:
- `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- A test proves the boundary rules reject a React import in core and an aircraft import outside the registry
- The test run fails when no tests are found

Spec: §3, §10

issues.title: CI: lint, format, typecheck, test and build on every PR
issues.body:
Scope: one GitHub Actions workflow with a job named `check`.

Done when:
- The job runs on pull requests and on pushes to main
- A failing test or lint error fails the job
- Dependency updates are automated for npm and GitHub Actions

Spec: §10

issues.title: Deploy the web app to GitHub Pages from main
issues.body:
Scope: build with the Pages base path and deploy on every push to main.

Done when:
- The published URL shows the app and its assets load
- The workflow fails if the built page does not reference the base path

Spec: §2, §10

issues.title: Issue and PR templates, labels, milestones and branch protection
issues.body:
Scope: repo hygiene.

Done when:
- Issue templates exist for feature, bug, new aircraft and new device
- A PR template asks for the closing issue, verification and the real-browser pass for UI changes
- main requires a PR and the `check` job

Spec: §10

issues.title: ADR-0001 architecture and aircraft contract; content and licensing policy
issues.body:
Scope: record the decisions from the spec and the content rules.

Done when:
- docs/adr/0001 records packages, boundaries and the aircraft and device contracts with their reasons
- docs/content-policy.md states the own-words and own-photos rule, handbook revision note and the in-app notice

Spec: §3, §4, §7

issues.title: BRAND.md: product brand derived from DocGerdSoft
issues.body:
Scope: docs/design/BRAND.md.

Done when:
- It lists the inherited tokens for light and dark with exact values
- It records the Violet accent (#6A57C4 light, #9A8BE8 dark) and the reason
- It states the chrome-only rule, the no-status-inks-on-panel rule and the legal rules

Spec: §6.1, §6.2

issues.title: Design brief: screens and states
issues.body:
Scope: docs/design/brief.md listing every screen and state to design.

Done when:
- It covers main layout on tablet and desktop, checklist pane per mode, outside view, picker, deviation summary, control details, device screens, light and dark
- It lists what the first canvas draft already covers and what is missing

Spec: §6.3

issues.title: Claude Design pass and handoff export
issues.body:
Scope: refine the canvas draft (the owner's private Claude Design canvas) and export the handoff.

Done when:
- All screens from the brief exist on the canvas, including the tablet layout with collapsed checklist
- The handoff package is committed under docs/design/handoff/ as reference only

Spec: §6.3

issues.title: Lock design: tokens file, no-literals lint rule, bundled fonts
issues.body:
Scope: apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css as the only place colours, type and spacing are defined.

Done when:
- Tokens exist for light and dark and match BRAND.md
- A lint rule rejects colour literals outside the tokens file
- Geist and Geist Mono are bundled, not loaded from a CDN

Spec: §6.2, §6.3

issues.title: Contract types and defineAircraft
issues.body:
Scope: types for controls, indicators, views, systems, failures, phases, procedures and appearance.

Done when:
- defineAircraft gives compile errors for a procedure item that targets an unknown control
- Every text field requires German and English

Spec: §4

issues.title: Control store with spring-return and momentary controls
issues.body:
Scope: holds control positions and applies changes.

Done when:
- A spring-return detent goes back when released
- A momentary control is active only while held
- A guarded control cannot move while its guard is on

Spec: §4.1, §5

issues.title: Systems runtime: step loop, tick and environment from phase
issues.body:
Scope: calls the aircraft step function on control changes and on a fixed tick.

Done when:
- Time-dependent effects advance with the tick and are deterministic in tests
- The phase's environment presets reach step
- An exception in step is reported, not swallowed

Spec: §4.4, §5, §8

issues.title: Reusable system blocks: electrical bus and piston-engine start
issues.body:
Scope: building blocks aircraft compose.

Done when:
- Starter with magnetos off does not start the engine
- Starter without bus power does nothing
- A running engine keeps running after the starter is released

Spec: §4.4

issues.title: Failure injection
issues.body:
Scope: activate and clear declared failures at runtime.

Done when:
- The active failure set reaches step
- Injecting an undeclared failure is an error
- A failure can trip a circuit breaker

Spec: §4.5

issues.title: Checklist engine: item kinds, completion and deviations
issues.body:
Scope: observes control changes and state; never blocks input.

Done when:
- Action items complete when their condition is met, including hold-until
- Check and confirm items complete when ticked
- A change to a non-target control and a tick on an unmet check are recorded as deviations

Spec: §4.7, §5

issues.title: Phase handling: entry snapshots and procedure end phase
issues.body:
Scope: switching phase and starting procedures.

Done when:
- Jumping to a phase loads its entry snapshot
- Completing a procedure with an end phase moves to it
- Starting an emergency procedure injects its failure

Spec: §4.6, §4.7

issues.title: Aircraft validator and CI wiring
issues.body:
Scope: validate every registered aircraft in CI.

Done when:
- It reports unknown targets, unplaced controls, missing translations, phases without image or snapshot, and undeclared failures
- Each finding names the aircraft and the offending id
- CI fails on any finding

Spec: §8

issues.title: App shell: layout, header, theme and aircraft registry
issues.body:
Scope: the page frame per the locked design.

Done when:
- Header, outside-view area, panel area and checklist pane are laid out for tablet and desktop
- Theme follows the system setting and can be switched
- Aircraft come only from aircraft-registry.ts

Spec: §3, §5, §6

issues.title: Panel renderer: views, placements and tabs
issues.body:
Scope: draw a view's background and place each control and indicator.

Done when:
- Placements scale with the panel
- View tabs switch views
- 3D position data is ignored without error

Spec: §4.3

issues.title: Panel kit: realistic generic GA controls
issues.body:
Scope: toggle, rocker, key switch, push button, circuit breaker, rotary knob, lever and guarded handle, for touch and mouse.

Done when:
- Each widget shows every position and animates between them
- Press-and-hold works for momentary and spring-return controls
- Hit targets are at least 44 px

Spec: §4.1, §4.8

issues.title: Panel kit: realistic generic GA indicators
issues.body:
Scope: round gauge with needle, ticks and coloured arcs; annunciator lamp; digital readout.

Done when:
- A gauge is configured by range, units and arcs
- Indicators hold no state of their own

Spec: §4.2, §4.8

issues.title: Panel kit: layer renderer for aircraft artwork
issues.body:
Scope: draw a control or gauge from image layers.

Done when:
- A needle rotates about a declared pivot over a declared angle range
- A switch shows one image per position
- A lever follows a declared travel path
- A missing image falls back to the generic widget

Spec: §4.8, §8

issues.title: Panel kit gallery page
issues.body:
Scope: a page showing every widget in every state.

Done when:
- Each generic control and indicator appears with all positions
- It is reachable in development builds

Spec: §4.8

issues.title: Checklist pane and deviation summary
issues.body:
Scope: the checklist UI and the end-of-procedure summary.

Done when:
- Done, current and upcoming items are distinguishable without colour alone
- Check and confirm items can be ticked
- The summary lists each deviation with the item it happened during

Spec: §5

issues.title: Modes: Guided, Practice and Free explore
issues.body:
Scope: the three modes.

Done when:
- Guided highlights the current target with accent plus a shape cue and switches to its view
- Practice shows no highlight
- Free explore shows control details on tap and has an operate toggle

Spec: §5, §6.2

issues.title: Outside-view strip
issues.body:
Scope: the phase image above the panel and the phase selector.

Done when:
- The image follows the current phase
- Selecting a phase loads its entry snapshot

Spec: §4.6, §5

issues.title: Translations: UI dictionary with parity check and language switch
issues.body:
Scope: German and English for the interface.

Done when:
- A missing key in either language is a compile error
- The language switch changes UI text and aircraft content
- The choice is remembered

Spec: §2, §5

issues.title: Error boundary, image fallback and start-up notice
issues.body:
Scope: failure handling in the app.

Done when:
- A runtime error shows a readable message and a reset
- A missing image shows a labelled placeholder
- The training-aid notice is shown on start
- The app works when localStorage is unavailable

Spec: §5, §7, §8

issues.title: Fictional demo aircraft
issues.body:
Scope: packages/aircraft-demo with controls, views, systems model, two normal procedures and one emergency.

Done when:
- It passes the validator
- Scenario tests cover starter without magnetos and starter without bus power
- It uses only generic widgets

Spec: §3, §4

issues.title: Generic procedure walk-through test
issues.body:
Scope: one test that runs for every registered aircraft and every normal procedure.

Done when:
- Starting from the phase entry snapshot, performing each item completes the procedure with no deviations
- A failure names aircraft, procedure and item

Spec: §9

issues.title: Browser tests
issues.body:
Scope: Playwright tests in CI.

Done when:
- A procedure is completed in Guided and one in Practice
- Language switch is covered
- Tests wait on state, not on fixed timeouts

Spec: §9

issues.title: Authoring guide: adding an aircraft
issues.body:
Scope: docs/adding-an-aircraft.md.

Done when:
- It walks through package, registry line, controls, views, systems, phases, procedures, appearance and artwork
- Following it with the demo aircraft as reference yields a validating aircraft

Spec: §4

issues.title: PWA: manifest, service worker, offline caching and update prompt
issues.body:
Scope: installable and usable without network.

Done when:
- After one visit the app loads and runs a procedure offline
- A new version prompts for reload instead of silently mixing versions

Spec: §2

issues.title: Touch polish: hit targets, press-and-hold and panel zoom
issues.body:
Scope: tablet use.

Done when:
- Small controls remain operable by touch
- Pinch zoom and pan work on the panel without moving the page
- Verified on a real tablet

Spec: §2

issues.title: Accessibility: keyboard operation, labels and reduced motion
issues.body:
Scope: operate the trainer without a pointer.

Done when:
- Every control is reachable and operable by keyboard
- Controls expose name and position to assistive technology
- Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion

Scope: collect and clear the source material.

- Indicators follow the model

issues.title: CTSL control and gauge artwork matching the real panel
issues.body:

Done when:

- Each asset has a licence note

issues.title: 3D renderer on the same aircraft data
issues.body:
Scope: a second renderer using the optional 3D positions.

Done when:
- The demo aircraft is operable in 3D with unchanged aircraft logic
- Needs its own design and plan before work starts

Spec: §2, §4.3

issues.title: Device contract and runtime
issues.body:
Scope: the shape of an avionics device and how an aircraft installs one.

Done when:
- A device declares controls, starting state and a pure step function
- An aircraft installs a device with placement, power bus and data inputs
- A device without bus power is off
- Procedure items can target device controls and test device state
- Lint rules keep device logic free of UI imports

Spec: §4.9

issues.title: Device screens in the panel
issues.body:
Scope: host a device's screen in a view.

Done when:
- The screen is drawn at its placement and receives input
- A powered-off device shows a dark screen
- Devices come only from device-registry.ts

Spec: §4.9

issues.title: Generic COM radio and transponder devices; authoring guide for devices
issues.body:
Scope: two generic devices installed in the demo aircraft, and docs/adding-a-device.md.

Done when:
- COM: power, volume, standby frequency entry, active/standby swap
- Transponder: power, modes, squawk entry, ident
- A demo procedure includes a device item
- Each device lists what it does not model

Spec: §4.9

issues.title: Avionics devices installed in the club's CTSL
issues.body:
Scope: tracking issue. Split into one issue per unit once intake (#37) has identified them.

Done when:
- Each installed unit has a device package with its base logic
- Each states the manual revision it follows and what it does not model

Spec: §4.9

issues.title: Claude Code project setup: plugins, hooks, agents and skills
issues.body:
Scope: committed .claude/ configuration so every agent session and worktree has the same tooling.

Done when:
- .claude/settings.json enables playwright, typescript-lsp, frontend-design, context7, pr-review-toolkit and superpowers
- A PostToolUse hook formats edited files with Prettier
- A ui-verifier agent does the real-browser pass at tablet and desktop width
- A milestone-release skill produces the owner summary and the release
